tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's monthly verification quota: plan, used, limit, and remaining. Call this before verify_photo to check the free-tier allowance.

tools.name: create_verification_upload
tools.description: Get pre-signed S3 PUT URLs to upload a large RAW + JPEG directly (avoids inlining bytes and bypasses request-size limits). PUT each file to its upload_url, then call verify_photo with the returned object_key values as raw_object_key / image_object_key.

tools.name: verify_photo
tools.description: Verify a photo's authenticity from a RAW camera file and its JPEG export. Provide the files either inline as raw_base64 + image_base64 (small files), or — for large files — call create_verification_upload first and pass the returned raw_object_key + image_object_key. Returns a verification id; poll

tools.name: verify_content_credentials
tools.description: Verify a single image's authenticity — use this when you only have the image and no RAW camera file. Checks its embedded Content Credentials (C2PA) for capture provenance and AI-generation flags, and runs advisory forensic screens (error-level analysis, double-JPEG artifacts, EXIF timestamp consiste

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Retrieve a verification by id: processing status and per-algorithm authenticity results. Completed single-image (image_only) verifications also include a verdict and a structured evidence_report with per-check findings and coverage. Works for both API-key callers (scoped to their account) and keyles

tools.name: list_verifications
tools.description: List the account's verifications, most recent first. Optional filters: status (pending|queued|in_progress|completed|failed) and result (true=authentic, false=not).

tools.name: share_verification
tools.description: Enable or update sharing for a verification you own. access_type is 'anyone_with_link' (public URL) or 'restricted' (only invited emails). Optionally pass invite_emails to grant access. Returns the share URL and invited emails. Anonymous verifications can't be shared.

tools.name: get_verification_share
tools.description: Get the current sharing configuration (access type, share URL, invited emails) for a verification.

tools.name: unshare_verification
tools.description: Disable sharing for a verification, making it private and invalidating its share link.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a marketplace listing by id: title, description, per-license pricing, terms, and sales totals. There is no public directory — you must know the listing UUID.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List the marketplace listings owned by your account (with pricing and sales totals).

findings.detail: Description of "verify_content_credentials" is 878 chars, far longer than this server's median (163). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_verification_upload, get_verification_share · Private data: create_verification_upload, verify_photo, verify_content_credentials, unshare_verification · Public sink: create_verification_upload, share_verification, get_verification_share, unshare_verification.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_verification_upload, get_verification_share · Private data: create_verification_upload, verify_photo, verify_content_credentials, unshare_verification · Public sink: create_verification_upload, share_verification, get_verification_share, unshare_verification

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
